name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia probe continues
summary: Indonesia detains three police generals over alleged wiretapping of Prabowo; no G20 government collapse reported
state: Indonesian police announced on 3 Nov the detention of three senior generals, including former national police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo, over alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo and others. Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra said investigators found no indication of treason (ABC Australia, 4 Nov). Searches on 8 Nov found no G20 government collapse, coup or contested election in the past month, so the status stays at Normal.
for_you: Nothing here currently changes daily life for most people. People in Indonesia and those with interests there are the most exposed if the inquiry widens, and it tends to affect relations between the police and the presidency first.
rubric_hit: Normal: no G20 government collapse, contested election or coup found in the past month as of 8 Nov.

sources.title: ABC News (Australia) — Indonesian police generals accused of illegally tapping phone of president and journalists

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
